data.body: Evidence (2026-11-20 PST). Inside the agent sandbox on origin/main: probe available=True, os.sysconf('SC_SEM_NSEMS_MAX') -> PermissionError [Errno 1], ProcessPoolExecutor(1) -> same error; the test fails 'PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted' (1 failed in 119.81 s). With commit 2b5e23a32c0 (Gerrit 3480; plain spawn-context Processes + one-way Pipes, no per-worker bound): inside the sandbox 1 passed in 208.76 s. The plan's first draft (widen the shared probe) was blocked in review because 3 other marked tests need only SemLock and would have been skipped needlessly; the revised plan passed. Local make verify not run for this change: all 3 shared verify slots were held by this session's other changes, and those runs show about 20 unrelated 300 s pytest-timeout expiries each at load 30-45 (see rubbery-adamantine-panda).
